verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration runs online application services and the UK Immigration: ID Check app, so opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics cookies or any tracking opt-out. The only privacy-related item, a guide to seeing the personal information UKVI holds about you, is an adjacent data-access right and earns no credit toward opting out of tracking.
